room_rent.display: Single Private AC Room (Plus); No cap (Power/Prime)
room_rent.note: Plus plan: Single Private AC Room. Power and Prime plans: Actuals (no cap). Optional add-on 3.7.5 allows change in room category.

icu.note: ICU charges are not proportionately reduced in any case per clause 6.4. No separate ICU sub-limit stated.

copayment.display: None (Zone A payers); 20% if Zone B insured treats in Zone A
copayment.note: Zone-wise co-payment: if premium paid for Zone B but treatment taken in Zone A, 20% co-pay applies. No co-pay otherwise. Voluntary co-pay (10%/20%) available as optional add-on for premium discount.

sub_limits.note: Maternity capped (₹1L–₹2L depending on SI); prenatal/postnatal OPD sub-limited to ₹10,000; vision correction sub-limited (optional cover); second opinion ₹5,000 (optional). Core hospitalisation has no disease-wise sub-limits.

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Voluntary Aggregate Deductible (₹10k–₹1L) available as optional add-on (Benefit 3.7.7).

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt. Waived after 12 months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting is 36 months. Reducible to 24 or 12 months via optional paid add-on Benefit 3.7.6. Chronic Shield (optional) covers 4 listed PEDs from Day 31.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions: ENT surgeries, gynaecological conditions, joint replacement, hernia, cataract, calculus diseases, etc. Accidents exempt.

maternity.display: Optional add-on (24mo wait for 1–2yr policy; 0/12/24mo for 3yr+)
maternity.note: Maternity Cover (Benefit 3.7.13.1) is an optional paid bundle. Limit: ₹1L (SI ₹5L) or ₹1L–₹2L (SI ≥₹10L). Covers normal & C-section, max 2 deliveries lifetime. Includes newborn baby cover and infertility (IUI/IVF) within maternity limit.

cumulative_bonus.note: Base: 33.33% of Base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces by 33.33% in claim year. Optional Guaranteed CB (Option B) upgrades to 100%/yr up to 300% with no reduction on claim.

restoration.note: Benefit 3.2.1: Unlimited reinstatement of Base SI after each claim settlement, for both related and unrelated illness/injury. Reinstated SI available only after Base SI + Extra SI/Double Cover + Cumulative Bonus exhausted. Inbuilt.

pre_hosp.note: Extendable to 90 days via optional Convenience Cover add-on (Benefit 3.7.10.1).

post_hosp.note: Extendable to 180 days via optional Convenience Cover add-on (Benefit 3.7.10.1).

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment as defined (technological advancement, <24 hrs, would otherwise need >24 hr admission) is covered under Benefit 3.1.1.2.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization covered (Benefit 3.1.3) within SI, min 3 continuous days. Excludes asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders and several other listed conditions.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered under Benefit 3.1.1.1 Hospitalization Expenses within Sum Insured.

organ_donor.note: Benefit 3.1.7: Organ donor's in-patient medical expenses covered up to SI, including pre/post hospitalisation for donor.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance: ₹1,500 per hospitalisation; intercity (beyond 100km): up to ₹20,000. Air ambulance available as optional add-on (7.5% of Base SI or ₹5L, whichever higher).

modern_treatments.display: Covered up to 100% of Base SI
modern_treatments.note: Benefit 3.1.4 covers 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy, etc.) up to 100% of Base SI.

consumables.note: Benefit 3.7.3.2: Consumables Cover is an optional paid enhanced cover. Covers List I–IV items within SI. Without it, List I items are excluded.

global_cover.note: Exclusion 4.2.12 explicitly excludes treatment received outside India. No international cover option available.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for all payment modes except monthly (15 days). Coverage not available during grace period except for instalment payers.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies only (not renewals or portability).

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Overseas treatment, sleep apnea, external congenital anomaly, hearing aids/spectacles, OPD treatment, self-injury, alcoholic cirrhosis (permanent)

optional_riders.display: Short Stay Treatment, Chronic Shield, Consumables Cover, Double Cover, Maternity+Newborn+Infertility, Guaranteed CB (A/B), Air Ambulance, Vision Correction, Home Care, Companion Cover
